subject: Mythology
title: The Norns: Weavers of Fate
description: A 60-second lesson on The Norns: Weavers of Fate.

hook.text: Three mysterious women sat at the roots of Yggdrasil, carving the destiny of every living thing.

buildup.text: Urd controlled the past, Verdandi shaped the present, and Skuld held the future in her hands.

discovery.text: They watered Yggdrasil each day and carved runes into its trunk, writing the fates of gods and mortals.

twist.text: Even Odin, king of the gods, could not change what the Norns had written. Fate bound everyone equally.

climax.text: The Norns knew Ragnarök was coming and carved it into the tree anyway, accepting the end of the world.

punchline.text: Even the gods had a deadline written by three quiet women.

quiz.question: What did the three Norns control in Norse mythology?
options: The weather, the tides, and the harvest
The past, the present, and the future
